title: Accept a batch blame once the named job has finished red
why: Owner 12:04 CST Nov 12, typed in batch runner 10: "Yes raise that -- time waste for no output gain is just wasted time."
note: `merge --batch-build N --blame PR --run URL` refuses while the run is still going (merge/merge.py about line 4921), so a batch waits for macOS and Windows after a finished red job already shows the cause (batch 104: red 11:55 CST, cause reproduced 11:57 CST). Fix: accept a blame once the named job has finished red; keep the refusal for a job still running. Red first.
